name: Casablanca
hook: The 1942 wartime romance whose lines and piano song Jeopardy quotes more than almost any film.

facts.label: 1942 premiere
facts.statement: Casablanca premiered in New York on Thanksgiving 1942, 15 days after the city's liberation, and gained fame after the January 1943 Casablanca Conference.

facts.label: "As Time Goes By"
facts.statement: Dooley Wilson's Sam "plays" "As Time Goes By" on a Warner Bros. prop piano that had only 58 keys.

facts.label: "Here's looking at you, kid"
facts.statement: Humphrey Bogart's Rick toasts Ingrid Bergman's Ilsa with "Here's looking at you, kid."

facts.label: the usual suspects
facts.statement: Claude Rains as Captain Renault orders officers to "round up the usual suspects," a line that titled the 1995 film The Usual Suspects.

facts.label: a hill of beans
facts.statement: Rick says the problems of three little people "don't amount to a hill of beans"; the trio is Rick, Ilsa, and her husband Victor Laszlo.

facts.label: Lisbon
facts.statement: The refugees, including Ilsa and Laszlo, escape to Lisbon; Rick and Ilsa had their affair in Paris.

facts.label: Michael Curtiz
facts.statement: Michael Curtiz, a Hungarian émigré, directed Casablanca and Mildred Pierce; Humphrey Bogart played Rick Blaine, AFI's No. 4 hero.
